title: InnovateX ’24 inspires 80+ future engineers
excerpt: Advanced Level students from Kandy district schools built Arduino projects, toured the faculty and competed in circuit design.
content:
InnovateX ’24 welcomed over 80 Advanced Level female students from Kandy district schools, empowering them with leadership skills and enriching their STEM knowledge.

The programme featured lectures on engineering and girls in STEM, a practical session on electronic components and circuits, a guided tour of the engineering faculty and hands-on Arduino projects. The top three circuit designs received prizes and all participants were awarded gifts.
